title: First Steps Helper: Minimum of Two Values
description: Booklet Section 10.2 helper selecting the minimum of two adjustable values A and B.

walkthrough.title: Generate A and B
walkthrough.text: P1 and P2 are mapped to full-range adjustable source stubs A and B.

walkthrough.title: Test A-B
walkthrough.text: INV3 forms -B. CMP1 receives A and -B, so its sign test is A-B.

walkthrough.title: Route the smaller value
walkthrough.text: The comparator positive branch is B and the non-positive branch is A, so OUT Y shows min(A,B).
